name: Ted Taylor
story: Ted Taylor appears in Eagle Technology case studies as a GIS account manager working with customer applications rather than only software sales. He is quoted on the Lucas Associates interactive native-plant application and on GIS-in-schools activity associated with Sustainable Coastlines.
